title: Sekigahara: The Betrayal on a Hill That Decided Japan's Fate
summary: Recounts the battle fought on the twenty-first of October, sixteen hundred, in Japan's Sekigahara valley between Tokugawa Ieyasu's Eastern Army and Ishida Mitsunari's Western Army, centred on Kobayakawa Hideaki, who waited on Mount Matsuo until noon before changing sides, and on the founding of the Tokugawa shogunate that would last two hundred and fifty years. The episode runs from the power vacuum left by Hideyoshi's death to the foggy morning, from Hidetada's army delayed at Ueda and late for the battle to Shimazu's retreat straight through the enemy lines, and from Mitsunari's execution in Kyoto to the defeated Satsuma and Chōshū clans bringing down the shogunate two hundred and sixty years later.
